description_en: Attaches shared storage to an Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc attach-shared-storages --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --shared-storages MountDirectory=/test VolumeType=nas ProtocolType=NFS FileSystemId=0bd504b000 MountTarget=0bd504b000-ngq26.cn-hangzhou.nas.aliyuncs.com StorageDirectory=/testehpc MountOptions=example-string Location=PublicCloud --api-version 2024-07-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachSharedStorages

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the file system to be attached
fields.name: file_system_id

fields.help_en:
The storage location of the file system to be attached. Valid values:

OnPremise: The file system is deployed on a hybrid cloud.
PublicCloud: The file system is deployed on a public cloud
fields.help_zh:
需要挂载的文件系统的存储位置。取值范围：
OnPremise：混合云集群。
PublicCloud：公有云集群
fields.name: location

fields.help_en: The local mount directory of the file system that you want to attach
fields.help_zh: 需要挂载文件系统的本地挂载目录
fields.name: mount_directory

fields.help_en:
The attaching options of the file system to be attached. Valid values:

-t nfs -o vers=3,nolock,proto=tcp,noresvport
-t nfs -o vers=4.0,noresvport

Default value:-t nfs -o vers=3,nolock,proto=tcp,noresvport

The v3 version is recommended for higher performance if multiple Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances do not edit the same file at the same time
fields.help_zh:
挂载的文件系统挂载选项。取值范围：
-t nfs -o vers=3,nolock,proto=tcp,noresvport
-t nfs -o vers=4.0,noresvport

默认值：-t nfs -o vers=3,nolock,proto=tcp,noresvport
在没有多台ECS同时编辑修改同一文件的场景时，推荐使用v3版本，性能更好
fields.name: mount_options

fields.help_en: The address of the mount point of the file system to be attached
fields.help_zh: 挂载文件系统的挂载点地址
fields.name: mount_target

fields.help_en:
The protocol type of the file system to be attached. Valid values:

NFS
SMB
fields.help_zh:
挂载的文件系统协议类型。取值范围：
NFS
SMB
fields.name: protocol_type

fields.help_en: The storage directory of the file system. You can mount any directory in the file system to the specified cluster directory
fields.help_zh: 文件系统存储目录。支持将文件系统内的任意文件目录，挂载到指定的集群目录
fields.name: storage_directory

fields.help_en:
The type of the file system to be attached. Valid values:

nas
cpfs
fields.help_zh:
要挂载的文件系统类型。取值范围：
nas
cpfs
fields.name: volume_type

parameters.help_en: The information about the shared storage resources that you want to attach to the cluster
parameters.name: shared_storages

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
执行命令并获取结果的过程是否成功。可能值：
true：成功。
false：失败
